title: COVER YOUR DECEMBER WITH GOD'S PROTECTION
text: I want you to open your Bibles with me to Psalm 91. I am speaking by the uncction of the Holy Ghost tonight. There is a dimension of divine covering that God wants to establish over your life as we step into this month of December. And I pray that the Lord will open your eyes to see what the spirit is saying. Psalm 91:1-2 says, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in him will I trust. You see, beloved, there is a prophetic significance to every season. The Bible makes us understand in Ecclesiastes chapter 3 that to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. December is not just another month on the calendar. December carries a weight in the realm of the spirit. It is a month of harvest. For some it is a month of conclusion. For many it is a month of acceleration. But it is also a month where the enemy intensifies his activities because he knows that time is running out. When you study spiritual patterns you discover that as the year winds down there is a convergence of spiritual activities. The kingdom of darkness understands timing. They understand seasons. And so what they could not accomplish in January, what they could not accomplish in the previous 11 months, there is a desperation to achieve it before the year runs out. This is why you must cover your December with God's protection. Now, I want you to understand something tonight. Protection is not the absence of challenges. Protection is the presence of divine preservation in the midst of challenges. When the Bible talks about the three Hebrew boys in Daniel chapter 3, they were thrown into the fire but the fire could not consume them. That is protection. Protection is not that you will never face battles. Protection is that in the battle no weapon fashioned against you shall prosper. Isaiah 54-17 declares, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord. and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. I decree over your life tonight that every weapon that has been fashioned against your December, it shall not prosper in the name of Jesus. Every arrow that has been released to cut short your testimony before this year ends, I command that arrow to backfire now in the mighty name of Jesus. You see, when we talk about covering your December with God's protection, we are talking about establishing a spiritual hedge. The Bible talks about this hedge in the book of Job. When Satan came to accuse Job, he said to God in Job 1:10, "Hast not thou made an hedge about him and about his house and about all that he hath on every side? There was a divine hedge around Job? There was a supernatural fortification. And until that hedge was temporarily lifted by divine permission, the enemy could not touch him. Tonight I am praying that God will rebuild every broken hedge around your life where the enemy has found access through sin, through disobedience, through carelessness, through ignorance. I pray that the Lord will repair those breaches and establish his wall of fire around you. Zechariah 2:5 says, "For I say the Lord will be unto her a wall of fire round about and will be the glory in the midst of her." Can I tell you something? Your protection is not in charms. Your protection is not in talisman. Your protection is not in carved images or in the traditions of men. Your protection is in the name of the Lord. Proverbs 18:10 says, "The name of the Lord is a strong tower. The righteous runth into it and is safe." The name of Jesus is your strong tower. It is your place of safety. It is your refuge in times of trouble. Now, as we step into this teaching tonight, I want to show you from the word of God different dimensions of divine protection and how to activate them over your December. Because you see, knowledge without application is merely information. The Bible says in Hosea 4:6, "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge." You must know and you must apply what you know. First dimension I want to show you is the protection that comes through dwelling. Psalm 91:1 says, "He that dwelleth in the secret place." The word dwell is not the same as visit. To dwell means to abide, to remain, to make your habitation. Many believers visit the presence of God, but few dwell there. You come to church on Sunday, you lift your hands, you sing, you worship, and then you leave and you go back to your normal life. That is visitation. But dwelling is when the presence of God becomes your permanent address. When you dwell in the secret place of the most high, you abide under the shadow of the almighty. And when you are under his shadow, you are covered. Listen to what the psalmist says in verses 3 to six. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence. He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shall thou trust. His truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasted at noon day. This is comprehensive protection. Terror by night covered, arrow by day covered pestilence in darkness covered destruction at noon covered 24-hour divine security. But this protection is conditional. It is for those who dwell in the secret place. Not those who occasionally visit, not those who are Sunday Christians, but those who have made the presence of God their dwelling place. So the first instruction for covering your December is this. You must intensify your fellowship with God. You must increase your prayer life. You must deepen your devotion. You must prioritize intimacy with the father. Because the closer you are to God, the more you are covered by his shadow. The enemy cannot reach you when you are hidden in Christ. Colossians 3:3 says, "For ye are dead and your life is hid with Christ in God." When your life is hidden with Christ in God, the enemy cannot locate you in the realm of the spirit. You become spiritually encrypted. Your coordinates are concealed. The demons may be looking for you, but they cannot find you because you are hidden in him. I decree over your life tonight, you are hidden in Christ. Every satanic track are looking for you this December, they shall not find you. Every evil monitoring spirit assigned against your destiny, they are rendered blind in the name of Jesus. You are covered by the blood. You are sealed by the spirit. You are protected by the power of the most high God. Now, the second dimension of protection I want to show you is the protection that comes through obedience. You see beloved, there is a hedge that God places around those who walk in obedience to his word. When you study the life of David, even though he was a warrior and he fought many battles, there was a season in his life where he was untouchable. Why? Because he walked in the counsel of God. The Bible says in 1 Samuel 18:14, "And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways, and the Lord was with him." When the Lord is with you, you are protected. But the Lord cannot walk with you in disobedience. The Bible says in Amos 3:3, "Can two walk together except they be agreed?" If you are walking in rebellion, if you are walking in sin, if you are walking in compromise, you are removing yourself from divine protection. Listen to what God said to the children of Israel in Deuteronomy 28:1-2. And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments, which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth. And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God. But then he says in verse 15, "But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day, that all these curses shall come upon thee and overtake thee." Do you see it? Obedience attracts blessing and protection. Disobedience attracts curses and exposure. So if you want to cover your December with God's protection, you must examine your life. Is there any area of disobedience? Is there any sin you are holding on to? Is there any compromise you have made? This is the time to repent. This is the time to make it right with God. The Bible says in Proverbs 28-13, he that coverereth his sins shall not prosper, but who so confessth and forsaketh them shall have mercy. You cannot cover your sin and expect God to cover your life. If you want divine covering, you must uncover your sin before God in genuine repentance and forsake it. I am calling for genuine repentance tonight. If you have been living in secret sin, if you have been living in compromise, if you have been living a double life, this is your moment to make it right. The Lord is extending mercy to you tonight. Don't let this December be the month of your downfall because you refuse to repent. Now, the third dimension of protection is through the word of God. The Bible is not just a book. The word of God is a weapon. Ephesians 6:17 calls it the sword of the spirit, which is the word of God. When you speak the word, you are wielding a weapon. When you declare the word over your life, you are activating divine protection. Jesus demonstrated this when he was tempted by the devil in Matthew chapter 4. How did he overcome? By the word. Three times the devil came with temptation and three times Jesus responded, "It is written. It is written. It is written." That is the power of the word. Psalm 119 to 105 says, "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet and a light onto my path." When you walk in the light of God's word, you cannot stumble into traps. You cannot fall into ditches. The word illuminates your path and shows you where the enemy has set snares. So, if you want to cover your December with God's protection, you must saturate your life with the word. You must meditate on the word day and night. You must speak the word over your family, over your business, over your career, over your finances, over your health. The word is your shield. Psalm 91:4 says, "His truth shall be thy shield and buckler." Truth is another word for the word. The word of God is your shield. When the enemy fires arrows of doubt, you deflect them with the word. When he fires arrows of fear, you deflect them with the word. When he fires arrows of sickness, you deflect them with the word. I want you to begin to declare these words over your life. I am covered by the blood of Jesus. I am protected by the power of the most high. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. I shall not die but live and declare the works of the Lord. The Lord is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid? A thousand may fall at my side and 10,000 at my right hand, but he shall not come near me. I am more than a conqueror through Christ who loves me. When you speak like this, you are not just making empty declarations. You are releasing the creative power of the word into the atmosphere. You are establishing spiritual realities. You are building a wall of protection through prophetic declaration. Now the fourth dimension of protection is through the blood of Jesus. Oh, the blood of Jesus. There is power, wonder working power in the blood. When the Bible talks about the children of Israel in Egypt on the night of the Passover, God said in Exodus 12:13, "And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you. When I smite the land of Egypt," the blood was their protection. When the angel of death came that night, he did not check their righteousness. He did not check their walks. He checked for the blood. Where there was blood on the doorpost, that house was protected. Where there was no blood, there was death. Tonight, I am declaring that the blood of Jesus is upon your doorpost. The blood is upon your family. The blood is upon your children. The blood is upon your business. The blood is upon your destiny. And when the angel of death comes trolling around this December, he will see the blood and pass over you. Revelation 12:11 says, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony." The blood has overcoming power. The blood speaks. Hebrews 12:24 talks about the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better things than that of Abel. Abel's blood cried for vengeance, but Jesus blood speaks mercy, protection, forgiveness. and victory. You must learn to plead the blood of Jesus over your life daily. Don't take it for granted. The blood is not just a theological concept. It is a spiritual weapon. When you say, "I plead the blood of Jesus," you are invoking the most powerful force in the universe. You are calling upon the finished work of Calvary. You are activating divine immunity. I plead the blood of Jesus over every person hearing my voice tonight. I cover you with the blood. I cover your family with the blood. I cover your going out and your coming in with the blood. I every satanic arrow that has been dipped in poison, I neutralize it by the blood of Jesus. Every evil covenant speaking against your life, I cancel it by the blood of Jesus. Every generational cause pursuing your lineage, it is broken by the blood of Jesus. The fifth dimension of protection is through spiritual warfare. You see beloved, we are not just living in a physical world. There is a spiritual dimension and there are battles that are fought in the spirit before they manifest in the physical. The Bible says in Ephesians 6:12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. If you are going to cover your December with God's protection, you must be a warrior. You must be violent in the spirit. You cannot be passive. You cannot be complacent. You cannot be lukewarm. Matthew 11:12 says, "And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffered violence, and the violent take it by force. There are some blessings you must fight for. There are some breakthroughs you must contend for. There are some territories you must possess through militant prayers. The enemy will not just hand over your December on a platter of gold. You must take it by force. This is why you must pray. Not just casual prayers, but violent prayers. Prayers that shake the heavens. Prayers that arrest demons. Prayers that bind principalities. Prayers that loose angels. You must learn to pray with authority. You must learn to pray with fire. You must learn to decree and declare. When you study the life of Jesus, he didn't just preach. He cast out devils. He rebuked demons. He commanded sickness to leave. He spoke to storms. He exercised authority in the realm of the spirit. And he has given that same authority to you. Luke 10:19 says, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy. And nothing shall by any means hurt you." You have been given power. You have been given authority. Now you must use it. You cannot sit down and fold your hands and expect the enemy to respect you. No, you must rise up and engage in spiritual warfare. I am teaching you tonight that there are times when you must war in the spirit. There are times when you must fast and pray. There are times when you must engage in nightlong vigils. There are times when you must bombard the heavens with violent intercession because the enemy is not playing games with your destiny. Daniel chapter 10 shows us a clear example of spiritual warfare. Daniel prayed and the angel came to him and said in verse 12-13, "Fear not Daniel, for from the first day that thou this set thine heart to understand and to chasten thyself before thy God. Thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words." But the prince of the kingdom of Pesha withtood me one and 20 days. Do you see it? There was a prince, a territorial demon that fought against Daniel's angel for 21 days. If Daniel had given up after 2 weeks, he would have lost his breakthrough. But he continued to pray. He continued to fast. He continue to war. And on the 21st day, the breakthrough came. There are some of you here tonight, you have been praying for something and you are about to give up. The enemy wants you to stop praying 3 days before your breakthrough comes. He wants you to quit when you are on the verge of victory. But I prophesy to you tonight, don't give up. Keep praying. Keep fasting. Keep worrying. Your breakthrough is coming. As you step into this December, I am teaching you to pray violently. Pray for your family. Pray for your children. Pray for your business. Pray for your destiny. Don't leave anything to chance. Cover everything with prayer. Now the sixth dimension of protection is through angelic assistance. The Bible teaches us clearly that God has given his angels charge over us. Psalm 91 to 11:12 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone." Angels are real. They are not fairy tales. They are not meats. Angels are ministering spirits sent forth to minister to those who are heirs of salvation. Hebrews 1:14 says, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation? There are angels assigned to your life. There are angels assigned to protect you. There are angels assigned to fight for you. But many believers are ignorant of this dimension of ministry. And so they do not activate angelic assistance. When you study the Bible, you see angels at work everywhere. An angel shut the mouth of lions for Daniel. An angel delivered Peter from prison. An angel strengthened Jesus in the garden of Gethsemane. An angel rolled away the stone from Jesus's stone. Angels are involved in the affairs of men. So this December, I want you to begin to pray and ask God to release his angels on your behalf. Pray that God will dispatch warrior angels to fight your battles. Pray that God will send guardian angels to watch over your family. Pray that God will commission ministering angels to bring you divine provision. Hebrews 13:2 says, "Be not forgetful to entertain strangers. For thereby some have entertained angels unawares." Angels can appear in human form. They can show up as that person who helped you when you needed help. They can show up as that stranger who gave you direction when you were lost. Don't be dismissive. Be sensitive. God may be sending angels your way. I decree over your life tonight. Angels of protection are assigned to you. Angels of deliverance are commissioned on your behalf. Angels of provision are dispatched to minister to your needs. This December, you will enjoy angelic assistance. You will experience supernatural interventions. Things will happen for you that you cannot explain. Doors will open that you did not knock. Favor will find you in unexpected places because the angels of the Lord are working on your behalf. The seventh dimension of protection is through holiness. The Bible says in Hebrews 12:14, "Follow peace with all men and holiness without which no man shall see the Lord." Holiness is not optional. Holiness is a requirement and holiness is a protection. You see, when you live in sin, you give the enemy legal access into your life. Sin is a breach in your spiritual world. Sin is an open door for demonic activity. But when you walk in holiness, when you live a consecrated life, when you separate yourself from the pollution of this world, you are fortified. You are protected. 1 Peter 1:15:16 says, "But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation." Because it is written, "Be ye holy, for I am holy." God is calling you to holiness. Not because he wants to restrict you, but because he wants to protect you. The devil is looking for whom he may devour. 1 Peter 5:8 says, "Be sober, be vigilant, because your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about seeking whom he may devour." Notice it says, "Whom he may devour, not whom he will devour." The devil cannot devour everybody. He can only devour those who give him access. When you live in sin, you are exposing yourself. You are making yourself vulnerable. You are removing yourself from divine covering. But when you walk in holiness, you are off limits to the enemy. You are untouchable. This December, I am calling you to holiness. Flee from sexual immorality. Flee from covetousness. Flee from lying. Flee from bitterness. Flee from unforgiveness. Flee from gossip. Flee from strife. Walk in love. Walk in purity. Walk in integrity. Walk in righteousness. This is your protection. The eighth dimension of protection is through the power of agreement. Jesus said in Matthew 18:1920, "Againain I say unto you that if two of you shall agree on earth as touching anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my father which is in heaven. For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them." There is power in agreement. When two or more believers come together in unity and they agree in prayer, heaven responds. This is why the enemy fights to bring division among believers. This is why he sws discord because he knows that when believers are united, they are unstoppable. As you go into this December, don't isolate yourself. Connect with other believers. Join a prayer group. Attend a bibleelving church. Surround yourself with people of faith. Because when you are in agreement with other believers, you multiply your spiritual strength. Ecclesiastes 4:9-12 says, "Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow, but woe to him that is alone when he fall, for he had not another to help him up." Again, if two lie together, then they have heat. But how can one be warm alone? And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him, and a three-fold cord is not quickly broken. You need spiritual brothers and sisters who will stand with you in prayer. You need people who will contend with you when the enemy comes against you. You need a spiritual family that will cover you in intercession. I decree over your life tonight, God is connecting you with divine helpers. He is bringing covenant relationships into your life. People who will pray for you, people who will stand with you, people who will believe God with you. This December, you are not walking alone. You have a spiritual family. You have a prayer covering. You are surrounded by believers who are in agreement with you. The ninth dimension of protection is through thanksgiving and praise. The Bible says in Psalm 100 to 4, "Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name. There is something about thanksgiving that creates an atmosphere of divine presence. When you are grateful, you are acknowledging God's faithfulness. When you praise him, you are enthroning him. And when God is enthroned in your life, the enemy cannot operate. 2 Chronicles 20 shows us a powerful demonstration of this truth. When Jehoshaphat and the children of Israel were surrounded by their enemies, God told them in verse 17, "Ye shall not need to fight in this battle. Set yourselves, stand ye still and see the salvation of the Lord with you." And what did they do? Verse 21 says, "And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the Lord, and that should praise the beauty of holiness as they went out before the army and to say, Praise the Lord, for his mercy endureth forever." They sent the praisers ahead of the army, and while they were praising, God set ambushments against their enemies, and they destroyed themselves. This December, you must learn to praise your way through. When the enemy comes with bad news, praise God. When the economy is crashing, praise God. When sickness tries to attack your body, praise God. When family problems arise, praise God. Because your praise is a weapon. Your thanksgiving is a shield. I decree over your life. You will not lose your song this December. You will not lose your praise. You will not lose your testimony. In the face of every challenge, you will lift up your voice and magnify the Lord. And as you praise him, he will fight your battles. He will scatter your enemies. He will make a way where there seems to be no way. Finally, the 10th dimension of protection is through the name of Jesus. Oh, the name of Jesus. There is no name higher. There is no name greater. There is no name more powerful. Philippians 2:9-11 says, "Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name, that at the name of Jesus, every knee should bow of things in heaven and things in earth and things under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord to the glory of God the Father." Every knee must bow at the name of Jesus. Demons must bow. Sickness must bow. Poverty must bow. Failure must bow. Every contrary wind must bow at that name. Acts 4:12 says, "Neither is there salvation in any other. For there is none other name under heaven given among men whereby we must be saved." When you speak the name of Jesus with faith, with authority, with understanding of who he is, things happen in the realm of the spirit. Devils flee. Chains break, doors open, mountains move. The name of Jesus is your access code into the supernatural. This December, I want you to use that name. When you wake up in the morning, declare, in the name of Jesus, I am covered. When you step out of your house, say, in the name of Jesus, angels, go before me and behind me. When you go to work, decree, in the name of Jesus, I have favor with God and men. When you face challenges, proclaim in the name of Jesus, I overcome. I am decreeing over your life right now in the mighty name of Jesus. You are covered. You are protected. You are secured. You are shielded. No evil shall befall you. No plague shall come near your dwelling. You shall walk through the valley of the shadow of death, but you shall fear no evil, for God is with you. His rod and his staff, they comfort you. This December is your month of divine protection. This December is your month of supernatural covering. This December is your month of angelic visitation. This December is your month of victory. You will not be a casualty. You will not be a statistic. You will not be a victim. You are an overcomer. You are a conqueror. You are more than a conqueror through Christ Jesus. Now, as I begin to pray, I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are. I want you to open your mouth and begin to pray with me. Pray violently. Pray with authority. Pray with faith. This is your moment to cover your December with God's protection. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, we come before your throne of grace tonight. Lord, we thank you for your faithfulness. We thank you for your mercies that are new every morning. We thank you that you have kept us through the year. Father, we are standing in the gap for every person hearing this message. We are covering their December with the blood of Jesus. Every satanic agenda for this December, we cancel it now in Jesus name. Every evil arrow that has been released, we command it to backfire seven times in Jesus' name. Every witchcraft operation, every occulties gathering, every satanic conspiracy against the children of God, we scatter it now by the power in the blood of Jesus. We decree that no weapon formed against us shall prosper. We decree that every tongue that rises against us in judgment, we condemn. We decree angelic protection over our lives, over our families, over our children, over our businesses, over our destinies. We decree that we are hidden in Christ. We are sealed by the Holy Spirit. We are covered by the blood. We are surrounded by the fire of God. Every spirit of death and hell assigned against us this December, we bind you now in Jesus name. You have no authority. You have no power. You shall not prevail. We release the waring angels of the Lord. Go forth and fight our battles. Destroy every demonic altar speaking against us. Scatter every evil council. Break every evil covenant. Nullify every satanic verdict. Father, we plead the blood of Jesus over our going out and our coming in. We plead the blood over our transportation. We plead the blood over our health. We plead the blood over our finances. We plead the blood over our relationships. We plead the blood over our minds. We plead the blood over our destiny. We decree that this December we shall not experience tragedy. We shall not experience calamity. We shall not experience loss. We shall not experience sorrow. We shall experience joy. We shall experience peace. We shall experience breakthrough. We shall experience victory. We shall experience abundant grace this December. Every closed door shall open. Every dry bone shall leave. Every dead situation shall resurrect. Every delayed blessing shall manifest. Every promise of God shall come to pass. We shall end this year with great testimonies. We shall end this year with songs of praise. We shall end this year giving glory to God. Every generational curse, we break your power in Jesus' name. Every limitation, we destroy you now. Every embgo, we cancel you. Every blockage, we remove you. We decree open heavens over our lives. We decree divine favor. We decree supernatural speed. We decree uncommon grace. We decree abundant provision. We speak to every mountain in our lives. Be thou removed and cast into the sea. We speak to every red sea divide now in Jesus name. We speak to every Jericho wall fall down flat. We speak to every storm. Peace be still. We speak to every giant. You are coming down in Jesus' name. Father, we cover ourselves with your feathers. We hide under your wings. We dwell in the secret place of the most high. We abide under the shadow of the almighty. We make you our refuge and our fortress. We make you our shield and our buckler. We trust in you completely. We shall not be afraid of the terror by night. We shall not be afraid of the arrow that flies by day. We shall not be afraid of the pestilence that walks in darkness. We shall not be afraid of the destruction that waste at noonday. A thousand may fall at our side, 10,000 at our right hand, but it shall not come near us because we have made the Lord our dwelling place. No evil shall befall us. No plague shall come near our dwelling. God has given his angels charge over us. They bear us up in their hands. We tread upon the lion and the cobra. We trample the young lion and the serpent under our feet. This December, we decree length of days. We decree divine health. We decree financial overflow. We decree marital bliss. We decree academic excellence. We decree business success. We decree ministerial fruitfulness. We decree every good thing that the enemy has stolen, it is restored sevenfold in Jesus' name. We thank you, Father, because we know that you hear us. We thank you because we know that you answer prayer. We thank you because we know that you are faithful to your word. We give you all the glory. We give you all the honor. We give you all the praise. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, we have prayed. Amen. Now lift your voice and begin to praise him. Begin to thank him. Begin to worship him because your December is covered. You are protected. You are secured. You are victorious. Nothing shall by any means hurt you. You are more than a conqueror. You are walking in divine immunity. You are under the shadow of the Almighty. Shout hallelujah. Give him praise. Magnify his holy name. For he is worthy. He is faithful. He's powerful. He's awesome. He's glorious. And he has covered your December with his mighty protection. Glory to his name forever and ever. Amen.
